research.title: Boundary-Aware Segmentation under Partial Occlusion
bullets: Formulated whether boundary supervision improves visible object segmentation under partial occlusion; led development of an auxiliary contour prediction branch.
Designed controlled occlusion experiments and ablations comparing contour supervision with standard segmentation losses, examining boundary errors across object sizes.

research.title: Illumination-Adaptive Consistency Learning for Object Detection
bullets: Investigated how illumination shifts affect detector confidence; led development of teacher–student consistency training with illumination-conditioned weighting of pseudo-labels.
Developed matched lighting perturbations and ablation protocols to separate localization and classification errors, examining sensitivity to pseudo-label thresholds and augmentation severity.

publications.title: Evaluating Object Detector Reliability under Controlled Illumination Shifts
Illumination-Conditioned Pseudo-Label Weighting for Consistency-Based Object Detection

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Local Feature Matching
bullets: Implemented patch descriptor matching with nearest-neighbor ratio filtering and robust homography estimation for image pairs containing planar surfaces.
Compared raw intensity and gradient histogram descriptors under rotation, blur, and brightness changes, inspecting correspondence errors and alignment failures.

projects.title: Image Classification with Limited Training Labels
bullets: Implemented supervised image classification baselines using a compact convolutional network and frozen pretrained features with a linear classification head.
Compared training strategies across controlled label subsets, tracking validation accuracy, class confusion, and sensitivity to augmentation while maintaining consistent data partitions.

projects.title: Classical and Learned Methods for Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented Gaussian filtering, nonlocal means, and a convolutional denoising autoencoder for images corrupted with synthetic additive noise.
Compared reconstruction fidelity and edge preservation across noise levels, using held-out images and visual inspection to characterize smoothing artifacts.
